items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: A fellow named Kurz, Alan Kurz, played the mellophone. And Orwin Kurz used to play at Club Forest with Jules Baduk. Orwin Kurz. And he and I and his son got it.

ctx.x: Yeah, two of them in the back.

And I always had two missing hip. When I lost these two that did it. So I think I can play about 90% of how I used to play, but I can't get up there and get those high notes anymore. But maybe if I played every night in a week I could probably do it, but that'll never happen again. In fact that hasn't happened in the last twenty years or maybe thirty years. But when you play every night you do get much better on a horn. Now any recording you've heard of me, especially since I've been in the union, right now these…
You're playing in the church sometimes. Oh, I've got plenty more. I've got a band.
